summary:
Repaired resubmission of the first research product for run 42242dc7 (previous operation bf761efec87e45629f7ce654be7a485a was rejected only because the final response was not pure JSON; the product itself validated). submission.json (action=research, repair_of=bf761efec87e45629f7ce654be7a485a) carries draft-relative map_path=map.json and 33 cited source ranges (S1-S33). Preflight via the trusted validate command reports valid=True with no diagnostics.

The map records, from read code plus membership.md, the two core relationships and their connection for hashicorp/raft (commit c0dc6a0b):
- A1 formation/advancement: pre-vote campaign (preElectSelf, no term change) -> real vote campaign (electSelf, persists term + self-vote) -> per-term vote grants (requestVote/requestPreVote with leader-stickiness, membership, log-up-to-date and one-vote guards) -> leader no-op + replication -> commitment advances commitIndex only at/above startIndex (first index of the leader's own term).
- A2 context/authority: durable current term + per-term vote, setState clearing the known leader, step-down-and-bump on newer terms, leadership transfer via TimeoutNow with the candidateFromLeadershipTransfer exemption.
- Connection: formation eligibility and the commit quorum are read from the latest configuration; config changes open only when latest==committed and the leader has committed an entry in its own term (configurationChangeChIfStable); old work is bounded by present authority (votes honoured only for their term, handleStaleTerm/step-down on newer-term replies, truncation rolling latest back to committed, inflight futures failed with ErrLeadershipLost on step-down).

Retained rather than smoothed over: 4 local anomalies in core_overview.open_details (appendEntries StoreLogs-failure TODO at raft.go:1541 leaving lastLog stale; electSelf returning a nil response channel on self-vote persistence failure at raft.go:2023; checkLeaderLease's nil-replState assumption at raft.go:1054; 'unexpected command' treated as a granted pre-vote at raft.go:2084), and 8 unmapped Surfaces headed by the high-consequence installSnapshot body and leader-side snapshot shipping. No obligation, check or defect is claimed this turn; next discriminator is to read those unmapped high-consequence paths and select a sourced question with a real guard/ownership/timing gap.
